## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Topic has a clear educational job.
- [ ] Source packet exists or source candidates are named.
- [ ] Scope avoids rankings, buying advice, market pricing, and review language.
- [ ] Related pages and missing ontology links are identified.
- [ ] Review status is appropriate for the source set.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run audit:quality`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` if routes, navigation, search, or layout changed.
